<subject>URGENT - REQUIRES IMMEDIATE ACTION - Nordwind Onboarding Tomorrow @The Elbphilharmonie</subject>
<body>
Date: Thursday, 23 January 2025

Location: The Elbphilharmonie Conference Center

The onboarding will be conducted in two sessions based on surname order. Sessions run from 10am to 1pm and 2pm to 5pm.

We strongly recommend attending your assigned session to receive important updates and have your questions addressed.

Please bring your Nordwind employee badge or a valid ID.

To expedite the process, complete the attached forms in advance, or you may fill them out on-site.

10am Session: Last names A-K

2pm Session: Last names L-Z

Check-in will be located outside the Baltic Room.

Bus Shuttle

Shuttles will leave from the main entrance of the Nordwind Tower, ground floor, at:

First session 				Second session  
8:45am-9am				12:45pm-1pm
</body>
